> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **176** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4ed453dc211f24114c36133cb016515f377d2d5c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `7f667c8bf41b7cc443e7217074d5cb559b5991de` — the merge of head `6fae8d6d8f9db745becb6483ba668a8b0f9f7532` into base `4ed453dc211f24114c36133cb016515f377d2d5c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 7f667c8bf41b7cc443e7217074d5cb559b5991de && git checkout 7f667c8bf41b7cc443e7217074d5cb559b5991de
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4ed453dc211f24114c36133cb016515f377d2d5c 6fae8d6d8f9db745becb6483ba668a8b0f9f7532 && git checkout -B drift-repro 4ed453dc211f24114c36133cb016515f377d2d5c && git merge --no-ff 6fae8d6d8f9db745becb6483ba668a8b0f9f7532

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4ed453dc211f24114c36133cb016515f377d2d5c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4ed453dc211f24114c36133cb016515f377d2d5c` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

Final green head for L1 and same-head contract review (2026-11-25T12:35Z): `6fae8d6d8f9db745becb6483ba668a8b0f9f7532`.

- **Checks at this head:** 59 `success`, 10 skipped (all 10 expected per `check-expected-skips`, exit 0), 0 failed, 0 pending. `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Size:** 31 files; `Fixes #36949`. `Clause-②: no`, measured: no zod file changed, and `check:generated` reports authorable-surface and api-surface up to date. `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **What it does:**
  - `dashboard.form.ts` enumerates the three `dateRange` children; Default Period is a select fed by the new `defaultPeriodOptions()` (`packages/spec/src/ui/default-period-options.ts`, not in the `ui` barrel). `report.form.ts` now reads the same function, so the two forms name a period alike.
  - The console's period-label helpers moved from `report-schema.ts` to `metadata-admin/default-period-labels.ts` (`localizeDefaultPeriods`); the report and dashboard inspectors both call it. The moved helpers had no reader outside app-shell's metadata-admin and are not in the package barrel.
  - Platform form catalogs regenerated; zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES worded by hand; the translated-label positive control moves 825 → 828 (the three new row labels).
- **Evidence:** two ablations (the spec options line, the zh gate) went red and were restored to HEAD; 89 of 91 derived gates ran green, with 2 NOT MEASURED (teardown-shape self-test needs history the shallow clone lacks; dual-build-cjs-loads needs a full build), the same pair as #36928.
- **For the contract review:** the PR changes spec form text (`dashboard.form.ts`, `report.form.ts`, the new options module) and owes an L2 contract review. The ja-JP/es-ES wording and the echo-decisions pin edit go slightly past the claim's stated surface; I accept both as direct consequences of the three new labels.
- **Overlap:** `overlap-check` VERDICT clean.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6fae8d6d8f9db745becb6483ba668a8b0f9f7532`
Local-runs: probe — the PR's three pin suites re-run at this head in a throwaway worktree (spec `report-form-default-range-labels-36835.test.ts` 4/4; app-shell `DashboardDefaultInspector.test.tsx` plus `ReportDefaultInspector.defaultPeriodLabels-36835.test.tsx` 13/13; platform-objects `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` 35/35), then five ablations, each red and each restored; worktree removed.
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.form.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/default-period-options.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts + ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/default-period-labels.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/DashboardDefaultInspector.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/report-schema.ts

Inputs read: card #36949 (body, triage comments, claim 7160359733, os-dev-report 7161766967), PR #37286 (body, 31 files, net diff against merge-base `f9fda2a4`), the precedent PR #36928 for #36835 and its record, and the 69 check-runs on this head (59 success, 10 skipped, 0 failed). `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --template --paths` on the PR's file list reads the schema face off the three spec paths above, so the tier owed is CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER whatever the `Clause-②:` line says. The rest of the diff (tests, the changeset, the platform-objects catalogs and their count pin) is the seat's L1.

### ① Derived judgments

- Same root cause as #36835: the form's `dateRange` composite gave the `defaultRange` select no named options, so the console fell back to the schema enum and listed stored values. On `main` the dashboard composite declares no children at all. Same fix shape as #36928: the spec form declares the row as a `select` with named options, and the inspector renames them for a zh designer from the console locale packs.
- One source of truth, held. `defaultPeriodOptions()` maps `DATE_RANGE_DEFAULT_RANGES` (the tuple `DashboardSchema.dateRange.defaultRange` and `ReportSchema.dateRange.defaultRange` both hand to `z.enum`) in its order. The names are a `Record` keyed by `DateRangeDefaultRange`: a missing member or an extra key fails to compile. The spec pin also asserts values equal the tuple, in order, and that the dashboard options deep-equal the report options. No hand list of values exists.
- Option set is exactly the accepted set: the 16 presets plus `custom`, 17 values, none missing, none extra.
- The three enumerated children (`field`, `defaultRange`, `allowCustomRange`) are exactly the three keys of the dashboard `dateRange` object in `dashboard.zod.ts`. Nothing drops from the panel when the declared list replaces the schema-derived one.
- `Clause-②: no` holds. No `*.zod.ts` file moved. The `ui` barrel exports the same names (`dashboardForm`, `reportForm`); `default-period-options.ts` is not re-exported. `report.form.ts` yields the same options as before (the #36835 pins pass unchanged). `Metadata-protocol: none` holds: no key, accepted value or default moved.
- Ablations at this head, all restored: (a) `dashboard.form.ts` back to merge-base: both #36949 spec pins red, and after a spec rebuild both inspector cases red (en finds no `Default Period` combobox); (b) the dashboard inspector's `localizeDefaultPeriods` call removed: the zh case red; (c) the three zh overlay rows removed: the zh positive control red (no `默认时间段` combobox); (d) the count put back to 825: red, `expected 828 to be 825`; (e) ja-JP rows put back to the English fill: the per-locale echo predicate red with 6 entries.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, with `Metadata-protocol: none`: correct. Form row and option names only. `Check Changeset` is green on this head. The changeset body carries both declaration lines and they match the PR body.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Open question 1 (the echo-decisions count and the ja-JP and es-ES wording, outside the claimed surface): answer A. The claim names "the locale packs for any label". Ablations (d) and (e) show the pin refuses the PR without the count move and without all three authored locales, so both are forced by the three new labels. 825 to 828 is three row labels, each authored in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES; the six help texts are not counted by that control.
- Open question 2 (helpers moved out of `report-schema.ts` with no re-export): answer A. At this head the only readers are the two inspectors and the #36835 test, all updated; app-shell is private and `Type Check UI` is green.
- Catalogs: en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES rows read correctly and reuse the report form's wording for the twin rows (`日期字段` / `默认时间段` / `允许自定义范围`, `日付フィールド` / `既定の期間` / `カスタム範囲を許可`, `Campo de fecha` / `Período predeterminado` / `Permitir rango personalizado`). The zh-CN catalog rows equal the app-shell zh overlay rows. The other eight locales carry the extractor's English fill with source hashes, the same state as the report rows.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff adds no query, id materialisation or join.
- Security: none.

### ④ Design judgment

- `packages/spec/src/ui/default-period-options.ts`: holds. A fresh array per call, typed to the enum, compile-pinned names. The jsdoc claim that the words are the period chip's holds for both chips: `DashboardFilterBar.tsx` and `ReportDateRange.tsx` read `dashboard.filters.range.*` and `dashboard.filters.custom`.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.form.ts`: holds against its first consumer. The `field` hint ("Leave it empty to use the creation date") matches the runtime default the dashboard plugin documents (`created_at`).
- `packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts`: holds. Behaviour unchanged; the inline table moved, not copied.
- `default-period-labels.ts`: the two helpers moved without change; `localizeDefaultPeriods` folds in the zh gate the report inspector had inline. Both inspectors call it with the same arrow-wrapped translator.
- `DashboardDefaultInspector.tsx`: the memo gains `appT` as a dependency, the shape `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` already ships. The rename runs before `stackSectionsForNarrowPanel`, which does not touch options.
- Known limit, carried from #36928 and stated in the PR body: `metadataForms` has no slot for option names, so non-zh designer locales and server-rendered forms read the English names. Not this card's scope.

N1 — `DashboardDefaultInspector.test.tsx`, zh case: the `waitFor` around the `本季度` assertion waits on an array already read, so it cannot retry. It still asserts correctly; a plain `expect` says the same.
N2 — The changeset says the three rows have "zh-CN catalog wording". ja-JP and es-ES are worded too; the sentence understates the diff.
N3 — es-ES: the new rows spell `período`, the parent `dateRange` row spells `periodo`. The report rows have the same split, and both spellings are accepted Spanish.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
